Package Model

Class Client

java.lang.Object
Model.Entity
Model.User
Model.Client
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class Client extends User implements android.os.Parcelable
A client user, extending User, with personal details and login state. Implements Parcelable for inter-component transfers.
